name: Jabba + Gamorrean Omi
description:
Jabba with the Gamorrean Guard omi is technically the strongest version of the team for TB, and allows you to auto missions sooner than other loadouts.
Gamorrean is generally not a great investment, and is not strictly advised. Embo, Boba or any other Hutt works well in this slot too.
notes: Jabba works solo with randoms till r7
Krrsantan and Boushh and 2 randoms allow r9
Full Hutt squad or Gamorrean omi allows auto at r9
